con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")

# Question 1
nrow(listings)

# Question 2
sum(listings$city == "Columbus", na.rm = TRUE)

# Question 3
chicago <- listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ]
max(chicago$price, na.rm = TRUE)
chicago[chicago$price == max(chicago$price, na.rm = TRUE), "name"]

length(unique(chicago$neighbourhood))

sum(listings$price > 1000, na.rm = TRUE)
